payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes k = a[4]+a[5]+a[0], then ans = k^2 - (a[0]^2 + a[2]^2 + a[4]^2) to get number of unit triangles.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a direct O(1) formula, not any search or enumeration. Candidate list only contains complete_search subtypes, so chosen search_backtracking per rule suggestion, with very low confidence and family_mismatch.
